mapper.select: select material_key from abr_plan_material where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and done = true
mapper.insert: insert into abr_plan_material (visitor_id, app_user_id, material_key, done, done_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{visitorId}, #{appUserId}, #{materialKey}, #{done}, case when #{done} then now() end, now(), now()) on conflict (visitor_id, material_key) do update set done = excluded.done, done_time = case when excluded.done then coalesce(abr_plan_material.done_time, now()) end, app_user_id = coalesce(excluded.app_user_id, abr_plan_material.app_user_id), update_time = now()
